notes: 本文件是从 Tychara 英文公开技能原文抽取的标准化中间层，不覆盖已人工确认的中文知识库。
未能从基础描述可靠推导的冷却、概率和效果字段保持 null，并通过 parsing.needsManualReview 标记。
公开资料主要覆盖韩服/日服，未在亚服客户端逐条验证。

skills.name: Order by Force
skills.descriptionEn: Increases self ATK by 15%. Grants self 2 stacks of Chill at the start of the first battle. Fills self action gauge by 35% proportional to the number of targets hit after using 7th Form: Earthshaker (up to 175%). Increases damage dealt by 30% if the enemy is under the effects of Freeze upon using 1st Form: Crescent Moon or 21st Form: Blade Gale.

skills.name: 1st Form: Crescent Moon
skills.descriptionEn: Charges alone and attacks the enemy in an instant. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.

skills.name: 7th Form: Earthshaker
skills.descriptionEn: Channels powerful force into two blades, then slams down to attack all enemies. 100% chance to remove 1 buff from all enemies. 100% chance to inflict 2 stacks of Freeze each on all enemies for 2 turns. 100% chance to inflict Isolation on all enemies for 2 turns. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.

skills.name: 21st Form: Blade Gale
skills.descriptionEn: Overwhelms the enemy with countless slashes that surge like a storm. Grants self Western Winds for 3 turns. 100% chance to inflict Stun on the enemy for 1 turn. 100% chance to reduce the enemy's action gauge by 20%. Action Gauge Reduction increases by 10% for each stack of Chill on self (up to 5 stacks). Removes all stacks of Chill after attacking.

skills.name: Stranis Style Breathing
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Asherah's ATK by 5%.
skills.descriptionZh: 提高自身攻击；使用 Veil Cleave 后提高自身暴击伤害，可叠加 5 层。

skills.name: Stranis Style Slash
skills.descriptionEn: Charges toward the enemy and delivers an upward slash. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Chill。

skills.name: Veil Cleave
skills.descriptionEn: Partially unleashes her magic blade's power to slash all enemies. Grants self SPD Up for 2 turns.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击全体敌人，并使自身获得 2 回合 SPD Up。

skills.name: Dawn of Night
skills.descriptionEn: Temporarily lifts the magic blade's seal to deal devastating damage to all enemies. Grants self CRIT Rate Up for 2 turns.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击全体敌人，并使自身获得 2 回合 CRIT Rate Up；Nova Burst 时额外造成 1 点韧性伤害并提高暴击率。

skills.name: L'unisson
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Asherah's Max HP by 5%.

skills.name: Belle Lame
skills.descriptionEn: Rushes the enemy and delivers a powerful upward slash. Grants self 1 stack of Insight. DMG is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Bal Doré
skills.descriptionEn: Emits radiant light and unleashes a blade aura to attack the enemy. Restores all allies' HP. Grants self Starlight Wish (Undispellable) for 2 turns and 1 stack of Insight. DMG and Recovery are proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Lumière Sonnet
skills.descriptionEn: Walks out on a red carpet to welcome allies. Restores all allies' HP and removes 2 debuffs from them, then increases all allies' (excluding self) Action Gauge by 15%. Grants self 1 stack of Insight. Recovery is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Approaching Rest
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Bell's Action Gauge by 30% and self ATK by 6% each time an ally or enemy (excluding self) is defeated. ATK increase stacks up to 3 times.
skills.descriptionZh: 除自身外任一单位被击败时，推进自身行动条 30%，并提高自身攻击，最多叠加 3 次。

skills.name: Obituary
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes cursed energy to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Leap；Nova Burst 时可施加 1 回合 ACC Down。

skills.name: Condolence
skills.descriptionEn: Binds multiple enemies with a curse and attacks all enemies. Inflicts all enemies with ACC Down for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Grants self SPD Up for 2 turns and 3 stacks of Leap.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击全体敌人，有 50% 概率施加 2 回合 ACC Down；自身获得 2 回合 SPD Up 和 3 层 Leap。

skills.name: Encoffin

effects.condition: Leap is at max stacks on attack

skills.descriptionEn: Attacks the enemy with the darkness of the underworld. Inflicts the enemy with Silence for 2 turns with a 75% chance and removes all buffs from them with a 100% chance. Deals 30% increased damage if Leap is at max stacks on attack.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，有 75% 概率施加 2 回合 Silence，并以 100% 概率移除其全部增益；Leap 满层时伤害提高 30%。

skills.name: Faint Emotions
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Besta's Max HP by 3%.

skills.name: Steadfast Lance
skills.descriptionEn: Charges in with her lance to strike the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Leap. Damage is proportional to her Max HP.

skills.name: Repel
skills.descriptionEn: Deploys her shield to obscure the enemy's vision before striking. Inflicts the enemy with ATK Down for 1 turn with a 100% chance. Damage is proportional to her Max HP.

skills.name: Unstoppable Charge
skills.descriptionEn: Channels Void Force into her lance and drops at full speed to strike the enemy. Grants self DEF Up for 2 turns. Damage is proportional to her Max HP.

skills.name: Rabbit's Luck
skills.descriptionEn: Charlotte grants herself 1 stack of Ignition at the start of the turn of a Sun Attribute ally (excluding self). Increases self Action Gauge by 6% after using Bunny Step. Triggers Bunny Step an additional time after using Bunny Step on self turn if self has Lucky Token (Undispellable). Additional trigger occurs once per turn.

skills.name: Bunny Step
skills.descriptionEn: Charlotte swiftly attacks the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: Song of the Toast
skills.descriptionEn: Charlotte casually raises a glass to rally all allies. Grants all allies ATK Up for 2 turns, then grants self Lucky Token (Undispellable) for 3 turns and a stack of Ignition with a 75% chance, 3 times total. Grants self an extra turn.

skills.name: Cornered Rabbit

effects.condition: Ignition is at max stacks after attacking

skills.descriptionEn: Having lost all her chips, Charlotte flips the table and attacks the enemy. Deals 5% increased damage for each Ignition stack, up to 5 stacks, on attack, then removes all Ignition stacks after attacking. Resets the cooldown of Cornered Rabbit if Ignition is at max stacks after attacking.

skills.name: Punctuality
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Claire's ATK by 3%.

skills.name: Perfect Strike
skills.descriptionEn: Swings her spear wide to strike the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.

skills.name: Menacing Blue Thorn
skills.descriptionEn: Pierces the enemy multiple times with a spear wreathed in razor-sharp energy. Grants self SPD Up for 1 turn.

skills.name: Final Service
skills.descriptionEn: Teaches a rude intruder a lesson by showing off her true skill. Increases self Action Gauge by 10%. Increases self Action Gauge by an additional 10% if she has a buff.

skills.name: I'll Take You On!
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Scarlet's Max HP by 3%.

skills.name: I'll Cut You Up!
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks the enemy with her detached Tailion. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: Let's Heat Things Up!

effects.condition: the enemy is afflicted with Burn on attack

skills.descriptionEn: Throws a Tailion heated with dragon's breath at the enemy. Grants self ATK Up for 1 turn. Deals 15% increased damage if the enemy is afflicted with Burn on attack.

skills.name: Think You Can Withstand This?!
skills.descriptionEn: Summons a vassal of the Bellarmini clan to unleash a superheated flame breath. Inflicts the enemy with Burn for 2 turns with a 100% chance, and inflicts an additional instance of Burn for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

skills.name: Knights' Shield
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Carmen's Max HP by 5%.

skills.name: Knights Standard Swordsmanship
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks the enemy with a heavy spinning slash. Grants self 1 stack of Chill. Damage is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Shock Therapy
skills.descriptionEn: Charges forward with a strengthened shield to strike the enemy. Grants self Rule of Monastir for 2 turns, and inflicts the enemy with Taunt for 1 turn with a 75% chance. DMG is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Monastir Mobile Bulwark
skills.descriptionEn: Carmen manifests her resolve to protect everyone as a bulwark. Grants all allies DEF Up for 3 turns, and inflicts the enemy with Taunt for 1 turn with a 75% chance. DMG is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Oath
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Carmen's Max HP by 15%. Grants the ally with the highest ATK with Oath of Devotion (Undispellable) at the start of the first battle. Takes 40% of damage dealt to the ally with Oath of Devotion (Undispellable) and increases self Action Gauge by 30% if an ally with Oath of Devotion (Undispellable) is attacked by a single-target attack. Only the highest damage-sharing effect applies. Restores all allies' HP after using Do Not Disturb. Removes all stacks of Chill and increases Recovery if Chill is at max stacks when using Do Not Disturb. Recovery is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Do Not Disturb
skills.descriptionEn: Carmen strikes the enemy with righteous fury after having her good time ruined. Grants self 1 stack of Chill. Damage is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Guardian Knight
skills.descriptionEn: Protects allies with a shield imbued with guardian power. Triggers Guardian Knight when an ally with Oath of Devotion is attacked. Restores an ally's HP and grants them Barrier for 2 turns. Increases the action gauge of self and ally by 30%. Grants self 2 stacks of Chill. Recovery and Barrier are proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Wedding March
skills.descriptionEn: Carmen tosses her bouquet to support her allies. Grants self 3 stacks of Chill. Removes all debuffs from allies, then restores their HP. Grants the ally 3 stacks of Chill if the ally is Moon Attribute. Recovery is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Spoke
skills.descriptionEn: Increases self ATK by 15%. Grants self Umbral Echo (Undispellable) for 1 turn at the start of battle. Increases self ATK by 6% for each stack of Agitation, up to 5 stacks, on attack. Restores HP proportional to 1% of Max HP upon receiving lethal damage. Does not get defeated. Grants self Immortality for 1 turn. Grants self Umbral Echo (Undispellable) for 3 turns. Resets all skill cooldowns. Occurs once per battle.

skills.name: Gesture of Dawn
skills.descriptionEn: Transforms dark magic into the form of crows to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Agitation.

skills.name: Guiding Twilight
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes the power within the Light of Dawn to attack enemies. Inflicts the enemy with Buff Block for 2 turns with a 100% chance. Reduces the enemy's Action Gauge by 25%. Grants self 1 stack of Agitation. Uses Guiding Twilight on a random enemy 1 additional time if self has Umbral Echo (Undispellable) after attacking. Additional trigger occurs once per turn.

skills.name: Dissonance Break
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes the flames of Dissonance imbued with the power of disintegration and collapse, attacking all enemies. Increases self Action Gauge by 30% and grants self 1 stack of Agitation. Deals 50% increased damage if self has Umbral Echo (Undispellable).

skills.name: Unshaken Grand Master
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Charlotte's ATK by 5%.
skills.descriptionZh: 提高自身攻击；升级后使用 Hyper 可叠加提高普攻伤害。

skills.name: Honest Thrust
skills.descriptionEn: Strikes the enemy with clean, disciplined swordsmanship. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Ignition。

skills.name: Vow of Victory
skills.descriptionEn: Shares her resolve for victory with one ally. Grants an ally CRIT Rate Up for 2 turns.Additionally grants the ally ATK Up for 1 turn with a 75% chance. Grants self an extra turn.
skills.descriptionZh: 使一名队友获得 2 回合 CRIT Rate Up，并有 75% 概率获得 1 回合 ATK Up；自身获得额外回合。

skills.name: Unyielding Strike
skills.descriptionEn: Displays the refined swordsmanship of the Monastir Knights. Inflicts the enemy with ATK Down for 2 turns with a 100% chance. Increases self Action Gauge by 20%.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，100% 概率施加 2 回合 ATK Down，并推进自身行动条 20%。

skills.name: Conviction Toward Victory
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Claire's CRIT Rate by 6% at the start of the turn. Stacks up to 3 times. Removes all Chill stacks and triggers Where Are You Looking? after using Faster Than Sight if Chill is at max stacks.
skills.descriptionZh: 每回合开始提高自身暴击率，可叠加 3 次；Chill 满层时使用普攻会清除 Chill 并触发特殊技能。

skills.name: Faster Than Sight
skills.descriptionEn: Quickly closes in, pulls her spear back, then thrusts it straight into the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Chill。

skills.name: Where Are You Looking?
skills.descriptionEn: Hits the jackpot to attack the enemy. Grants self ATK Up for 2 turns and increases self Action Gauge by 30%. Grants self 3 stacks of Chill on Critical Hit.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，使自身获得 2 回合 ATK Up，并推进自身行动条 30%；暴击时获得 3 层 Chill。

skills.name: Bunny Jackpot
skills.descriptionEn: Tosses and detonates a lucky card to attack the enemy. Increases self CRIT Rate by 20% on attack. Grants self Jackpot Bloom for 3 turns after attacking. Deals 10% increased damage for each buff on the enemy, up to 5 buffs.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，攻击时提高自身暴击率，并获得 3 回合 Jackpot Bloom；敌方每个增益使伤害提高 10%，最多计算 5 个。

skills.name: Winding Windpath
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Clarissa's CRIT Rate by 3%.

skills.name: Step Back a Bit
skills.descriptionEn: Snipes the enemy with perfect form. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.

skills.name: Shooting by Instinct
skills.descriptionEn: Snipes the enemy off guard. Inflicts the enemy with SPD Down for 1 turn with a 100% chance.

skills.name: This Is How You Shoot a Gun
skills.descriptionEn: Pinpoints the enemy's hidden weak spot using superhuman eyesight and snipes. Grants self SPD Up for 2 turns.

skills.name: Pure Heart
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Dana's ATK by 5%.

skills.name: Leaf Barrage
skills.descriptionEn: Dana unleashes nature's energy to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.

skills.name: Rapid Bloom
skills.descriptionEn: Promotes rapid plant growth using nature's energy to attack the enemy. Grants ATK Up to self and the ally with the highest ATK (excluding Dana) for 2 turns.

skills.name: Power of Nature
skills.descriptionEn: Imbues the earth with vitality and grows a giant tree to attack all enemies. Inflicts all enemies with SPD Down for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

skills.name: Timid Prayer
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Elisa's Max HP by 5%.

skills.name: Please Go Back
skills.descriptionEn: Elisa delivers divine judgment with her resolve-imbued flail. Grants self 1 stack of Agitation.

skills.name: A Futile Attempt to Help
skills.descriptionEn: Elisa offers a desperate prayer to overcome her fears and worries. Restores an ally's HP and grants them Holy Blessing for 2 turns. Grants self 2 stacks of Agitation. Recovery is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Let Us Pray Together
skills.descriptionEn: Elisa's faith calls forth a miracle from within the depths of despair. Revives a fallen ally with 50% HP and increases their Action Gauge by 80%. Restores the ally's HP and grants them Holy Blessing for 2 turns with a 75% chance, then increases their Action Gauge by 40% if the ally is not fallen. Grants self 2 stacks of Agitation. Recovery is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Ready Maid
skills.descriptionEn: Grants Emily Barrier for 1 turn at the start of the first battle. Reduces the cooldown of Turn-Down Service by 1 turn after being attacked. Reduces the cooldown of Turn-Down Service by 1 additional turn, then grants self 1 stack of Chill with a 50% chance after being attacked by an attack that targets all. Barrier is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Commence Combat Cleanup
skills.descriptionEn: Swings a massive broom to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Chill. DMG is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Cleaning Service
skills.descriptionEn: Cleanses allies with the pride of a cleanup maid. Grants an ally ATK Up and Barrier for 3 turns, and grants self 3 stacks of Chill, then grants self an extra turn. Barrier is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Turn-Down Service
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks all enemies with the resolve of a veteran mercenary. Grants all allies DEF Up for 2 turns, and grants self 1 stack of Awakened Memory (Undispellable). Removes all stacks of Chill and reduces the cooldown of Turn-Down Service by 2 turns if Chill is at max stacks after attacking. DMG is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Noble Bearing
skills.descriptionEn: Grants self 1 stack of Chill when a Moon Attribute ally triggers a Critical Hit. Deals 10% increased damage when Epindel uses Orlan Style Swordsmanship at max stacks of Chill. Removes all stacks of Chill after using Orlan Style Swordsmanship.

skills.name: Orlan Style Swordmanship
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks the enemy with House Orlan's dual sword style. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.

skills.name: Relentless Effort
skills.descriptionEn: Sharpens her focus, recalling the pride of Orlan. Grants self Immunity for 2 turns and grants self a stack of Chill additionally with a 75% chance, 3 times total. Grants self an extra turn.

skills.name: Hawk of Orlan
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes a hawk-shaped spirit sword slash and follows up to strike the enemy. Grants self SPD Up for 2 turns.

skills.name: Purewhite Resolve
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Epindel's ATK by 15%. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition when an ally triggers a Critical Hit. Grants self 2 stacks of Ignition each with a 100% chance at the start of the turn of a Sun Attribute ally.

skills.name: Falconet Strike
skills.descriptionEn: Dashes into the enemy's opening and cuts them down with dual swords. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: Bouquet Toss
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks enemies distracted by the bouquet toss. Reduces the enemy's Action Gauge by 20% with a 100% chance. Deals an additional 150% damage if the enemy has Barrier on attack. Increases the ally with highest ATK (excluding self)'s Action Gauge by 30% if Barrier is broken after attacking. Grants self an extra turn if Ignition is at max stacks after attacking on self turn. Grants ATK Up for 2 turns, then removes all stacks of Ignition.

skills.name: Bride's Entrance
skills.descriptionEn: Having made up her mind, Epindel punishes those who interfere with the wedding. Grants self SPD Up for 2 turns. Reduces the action gauge of the target with Barrier by 20% on attack. Increases damage dealt by 15% per the enemy's Barrier, up to 3 Barriers.

skills.name: Cash In
skills.descriptionEn: Frey removes all Chill stacks and grants herself 1 stack of High Roller (Undispellable) if Chill is at max stacks at the start of the turn. Chill stacks are not removed if High Roller (Undispellable) is at max stacks at the start of the turn. Increases self Action Gauge by 8%, then grants self 1 stack of High Roller (Undispellable) with a 50% chance after a Moon Attribute ally (excluding self) attacks.

skills.name: Bet Refusal
skills.descriptionEn: Frey slaps the enemy across the face with all her might in response to their ridiculous bet. Grants self 1 stack of Chill. Uses Forced Negotiation instead of Bet Refusal when using this Skill on self turn at max High Roller (Undispellable) stacks. Forced Negotiation: Frey brings down a crushing blow on the enemy in response to their ridiculous bet. Deals 100% increased damage on attack. Increases self Action Gauge by 30% and grants self 1 stack of Chill after attacking, then removes High Roller (Undispellable).

skills.name: All In
skills.descriptionEn: Frey wagers all her chips to support all allies. Grants all allies CRIT Rate Up for 3 turns, then grants self a stack of Chill with a 75% chance, 3 times total. Grants self an extra turn.

skills.name: Bullseye
skills.descriptionEn: Frey throws darts and lands a high score to attack all enemies. Grants self ATK Up for 2 turns, and grants self a stack of High Roller (Undispellable) with a 75% chance, 3 times total.

skills.name: You Bullying My Boys?
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Harley's Max HP by 5%.

skills.name: Let's Go, Dave!
skills.descriptionEn: Harley and Dave dart in to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: You Wanna Go?
skills.descriptionEn: Using Dave as a springboard, Harley leaps up and hurls her axe at the enemy. Grants self SPD Up for 2 turns and grants 3 stacks of Ignition to the Sun Attribute ally with the highest ATK. Reduces the enemy's Action Gauge by 25% with a 100% chance. DMG is proportional to self SPD.

skills.name: Chicken Race!
skills.descriptionEn: Harley calls in the hog pack to charge forth. Grants all allies DEF Up for 2 turns. Grants all allies (excluding self) SPD Up for 1 turn with a 75% chance if self HP is 50% or above, and grants self Berserk Mode (Undispellable) for 3 turns if self HP is 50% or below. DMG is proportional to self SPD.

skills.name: Eroded Emotions
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Haydee's DEF by 5%.

skills.name: Steel Hail
skills.descriptionEn: Fires Void Force condensed in Haydee's flower to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.

skills.name: Spiked Armor
skills.descriptionEn: Haydee wraps herself in Void Force as a defensive measure. Grants self Barrier and DEF Up for 3 turns. Removes all Leap stacks and grants self an extra turn if Leap is at max stacks. Barrier is proportional to self DEF.

skills.name: Thorned Grave
skills.descriptionEn: Haydee gathers as much Void Force as she can handle, then unleashes it on the enemy. Grants self Guard for 2 turns, and inflicts the enemy with ACC Down for 2 turns with a 100% chance. Deals 20% increased damage on attack if self has Barrier. DMG is proportional to self DEF.

skills.name: Valkyrie's Will
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Hilde's Preemptive Guard Chance by 10% and grants all allies (excluding self) Barrier for 1 turn at the start of the first battle. Barrier is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Twin Blade
skills.descriptionEn: Quickly closes in on the enemy and slashes with two swords. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition. Damage is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Dragon Buster
skills.descriptionEn: Pierces through the enemy, then leaps and strikes down. Grants self Immunity and DEF Up for 2 turns. Removes all Ignition stacks and reduces the cooldown of Dragon Buster by 1 turn if Ignition is at max stacks after attacking. Damage is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Buster Overdrive
skills.descriptionEn: Charges forward and bombards all enemies. Grants self Fafnir's Descent (Undispellable) for 3 turns and inflicts the enemy with the highest Action Gauge with Taunt for 1 turn with a 75% chance. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition. Barrier and damage are proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Flesh-Cutting Kotodama
skills.descriptionEn: Kyra deals 6% increased damage when using a Skill if she has Stealth.

skills.name: Unusual Greeting
skills.descriptionEn: Stages an accidental bump to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: Price of Silence
skills.descriptionEn: Uses her Kotodama to force the enemy to imagine a grim future. Grants self ATK Up for 2 turns. Reduces the enemy's Action Gauge by 20% if self has Stealth.

skills.name: Distorted Attention
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes her Kotodama to curse the enemy with misfortune. Grants self Stealth for 2 turns and inflicts the enemy with ATK Down for 1 turn with a 100% chance.

skills.name: Wish-Bearing Script
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Lacy's Action Gauge by 6% and restores her HP after she is attacked by an enemy afflicted with Entangled Dream. Recovery is proportional to her ATK.
skills.descriptionZh: 受到带有 Entangled Dream 的敌人攻击时，推进自身行动条 6%，并按自身攻击力恢复生命。

skills.name: Ascending Fire Dragon
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes a fiery breath to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Agitation.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Agitation。

skills.name: Upstream Water Prison

effects.condition: the enemy is afflicted with Entangled Dream on attack

skills.descriptionEn: Forms a reversing water surge to attack the enemy. Grants self SPD Up for 2 turns. Deals 20% increased damage if the enemy is afflicted with Entangled Dream on attack.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，使自身获得 2 回合 SPD Up；目标带有 Entangled Dream 时伤害提高 20%。

skills.name: Song of Water and Fire
skills.descriptionEn: Slashes the enemy with a blade infused with water and fire. Grants self ATK Up for 2 turns, and inflicts all enemies with Entangled Dream for 3 turns with a 75% chance.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击全体敌人，使自身获得 2 回合 ATK Up，并有 75% 概率施加 3 回合 Entangled Dream。

skills.name: Mystery Duo
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Lily's ATK by 5%.

skills.name: Strike Amidst the Chaos
skills.descriptionEn: Borrows Mr. Rabbit's mysterious power to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.

skills.name: Lily's Precious Moment
skills.descriptionEn: Fixes Mr. Rabbit on the spot to find a breakthrough. Grants all allies (excluding self) Barrier for 2 turns, and grants self ATK Up and Mr. Rabbit's Detective Consulting for 2 turns. Barrier is proportional to self ATK.

skills.name: Mr. Rabbit's Instant Verdict
skills.descriptionEn: In a moment of crisis, Mr. Rabbit steps in and attacks all enemies. Inflicts all enemies with ATK Down for 2 turns with a 75% chance. Deals 30% increased damage if self has Mr. Rabbit's Detective Consulting on attack.

skills.name: Way of the Exorcist
skills.descriptionEn: Inflicts the enemy with Freeze for 1 turn with a 50% chance after Lugh uses Subdual Charm.

skills.name: Subdual Charm
skills.descriptionEn: Throws a charm to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.

skills.name: Winterborne Quartet
skills.descriptionEn: Conjures cold air with a charm to attack the enemy. Inflicts the enemy with Freeze for 2 turns with a 75% chance, and grants self SPD Up for 1 turn.

skills.name: Heaven Forbids Evil, Justice Strikes
skills.descriptionEn: Strikes down evil with a charm-forged blade. Inflicts the enemy with DEF Down for 2 turns with a 75% chance, and increases the enemy's Ultimate Skill cooldown by 1 turn with a 100% chance.

skills.name: Girl Who Sees the Future
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Luna's ATK by 5%.
skills.descriptionZh: 提高自身攻击；使用 Hyper 时若自身处于增益状态，则提高自身暴击伤害。

skills.name: Defensive Mana Shot
skills.descriptionEn: Snaps her fingers to fire a conjured mana orb at enemies. Grants self 1 stack of Insight.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击全体敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Insight。

skills.name: Hecate's Ember
skills.descriptionEn: Channels lunar mana into her hat and blasts it into the enemy's center. Grants self CRIT Rate Up for 2 turns.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击全体敌人，并使自身获得 2 回合 CRIT Rate Up。

skills.name: The World I See
skills.descriptionEn: Draws out the Moon Staff's power to deliver enemies an inescapable fate. Inflicts all enemies with Bind for 2 turns with a 50% chance.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击全体敌人，并有 50% 概率施加 2 回合 Bind；Nova Burst 时 Bind 概率提高至 100%。

skills.name: Seeker of the Void
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Lydia's ATK by 4% and inflicts the enemy with Unknown Hex for 1 turn with a 100% chance after using Touch of the Void if the enemy has a debuff. ATK increase stacks up to 5 times.

skills.name: Touch of the Void
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks the enemy using an unknown force. Grants self 1 stack of Agitation.

skills.name: Invitation Beyond the Stars
skills.descriptionEn: Summons Kuku's tentacle to attack all enemies. Inflicts all enemies with Unknown Hex for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

skills.name: Void Within the Tome
skills.descriptionEn: Temporarily lifts Kuku's seal, unleashing an indescribable terror into reality. Inflicts the enemy with SPD Down for 2 turns with a 75% chance. Increases self Action Gauge by 30% if the enemy has a debuff on attack.

skills.name: Hammer and Anvil
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Marcille's CRIT Rate by 3%.

skills.name: Nut Twist
skills.descriptionEn: Swings her wrench with full force to attack the enemy. Grants 1 stack of Ignition to self.

skills.name: Nail Drive
skills.descriptionEn: Fires her modified nail gun at the enemy. Inflict the enemy with Burn for 1 turn with a 100% chance. Grants SPD Up to self for 1 turn on Critical hit.

skills.name: Screw Breaker
skills.descriptionEn: Activates her wrench at maximum output to clear everything in front of her. Grants ATK Up to self for 2 turns. Inflict the enemy with Recovery Down for 1 turn with a 100% chance on Critical hit.

skills.name: Triumphant
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Muriel's CRIT DMG by 15%.

skills.name: Divine Flame
skills.descriptionEn: Sends holy flames to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: Holy Bombardment
skills.descriptionEn: Throws stolen holy water at the enemy. Deals 3% increased damage for each debuff on the enemy. Extends all of the enemy's debuffs by 1 turn with a 75% chance.

skills.name: I'll Be Good From Now On
skills.descriptionEn: The divine punishment meant for Muriel engulfs all enemies instead. Inflicts all enemies with ATK Down for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Inflicts all enemies with Burn for 2 turns with a 100% chance if Ignition is at max stacks.

skills.name: Career Ambitions
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Naru's ATK by 3%.

skills.name: Eyes on Me!
skills.descriptionEn: Channels the power of the stars into her sextant and fires at the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.

skills.name: Behold My Skill!

effects.condition: the enemy has a debuff on attack

skills.descriptionEn: Calculates possibility of falling trajectories on the enemy. Grants self ATK Up for 1 turn. Deals 10% increased damage if the enemy has a debuff on attack.

skills.name: Beyond Expectations!
skills.descriptionEn: Performs an unstable energy-release equation with overflowing confidence. Inflicts the enemy with SPD Down for 2 turns with a 75% chance.

skills.name: Auto-Hunt System
skills.descriptionEn: Omega grants herself 1 stack of Leap with a 70% chance after a Star Attribute ally (excluding self) attacks. Removes all Leap stacks and grants self 1 stack of Power-Up Star if Leap is at max stacks at the start of the turn. Leap stacks are not removed if Power-Up Star is at max stacks at the start of the turn.
skills.descriptionZh: 星属性队友攻击后有概率获得 Leap；回合开始时 Leap 满层则转化为 Power-Up Star。

skills.name: Pew Pew!
skills.descriptionEn: Fires three short laser shots to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Leap。

skills.name: Mega Punch!
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks all enemies with a wide-area projection punch. Grants self 1 stack of Leap. The applied effect changes based on the number of stacks of Power-Up Star. Additional instances of Mega Punch! triggered by Mega Punch! only trigger on self turn. 1 stack of Power-Up Star: Triggers Mega Punch! 1 additional time. 2 stacks of Power-Up Star: Triggers Mega Punch! 2 additional times. 3 stacks of Power-Up Star: Deals 10% increased damage and triggers Mega Punch! 2 additional times.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击全体敌人并获得 1 层 Leap；根据 Power-Up Star 层数追加释放，3 层时额外提高伤害。

skills.name: The Biggest and Coolest One!
skills.descriptionEn: Summons and detonates the biggest and coolest item registered in the database to attack the enemy. Grants self ATK Up for 2 turns and 3 stacks of Leap.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，使自身获得 2 回合 ATK Up 和 3 层 Leap。

skills.name: Pre-Construction Review
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Petra's ATK by 5%.

skills.name: Improvised Blueprints
skills.descriptionEn: Petra slams her blueprints down on the enemy to attack. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: Breaking Ground
skills.descriptionEn: Petra pulls a bomb from her side bag and hurls it at the enemy. Grants self SPD Up for 2 turns, and grants self 2 stacks of Ignition.

skills.name: Construction Negotiations
skills.descriptionEn: Petra rolls out a barrage of bombs to attack the enemy. Inflicts the enemy with DEF Down for 2 turns with a 75% chance.Deals 4% increased damage for each Ignition stack, up to 5 stacks on attack, and removes all Ignition stacks after attacking.

skills.name: Veteran's Instinct

effects.condition: self HP is 50% or above, and deals 12% increased damage if self HP is below 50%

skills.descriptionEn: Increases Roberta’s CRIT Rate by 50% on attack. Deals 6% increased damage if self HP is 50% or above, and deals 12% increased damage if self HP is below 50%.

skills.name: Commence Operation
skills.descriptionEn: Strikes the enemy with a rapid flurry of punches. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.

skills.name: Fast Track
skills.descriptionEn: Triggers Fast Track on the attacker after being attacked by an attack that targets all. Removes 1 debuff from self when using this Skill. Increases self Action Gauge by 15% and grants self 1 stack of Leap after attacking. Reduces the cooldown of Fast Track by 1 turn on Critical Hit.

skills.name: On-Site Emergency Judgment
skills.descriptionEn: Based on a field assessment, skips procedure and immediately takes decisive force to attack the enemy. Grants self ATK Up for 2 turns and increases self Action Gauge by 15%. Removes all Leap stacks and additionally increases self Action Gauge by 20% if Leap is at max stacks.

skills.name: Tyrant of the North
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Rosaria's chance to grant self 1 stack of Inferno (Undispellable) after using Ashen Inferno by 20% per stack of Agitation, up to 5 stacks of Agitation. Prevents self current HP from dropping below 40% and grants self ATK UP for 1 turn after being attacked by an attack that would take self HP under 40%. The effect that triggers after being attacked occurs once per battle.

skills.name: Ashen Inferno
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes an ashen inferno at the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Agitation.

skills.name: Ruler's Judgement
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes an inferno of condemnation to ravage the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Agitation. The applied effect changes based on the number of stacks of Inferno (Undispellable). Removes all Inferno (Undispellable) stacks after attacking. 1 stack of Inferno (Undispellable): Deals 10% increased damage. 2 stacks of Inferno (Undispellable): Deals 20% increased damage. 3 stacks of Inferno (Undispellable): Deals 20% increased damage and triggers Ashen Inferno.

skills.name: Difference in Class
skills.descriptionEn: Swings her sword to cleave a planet, attacking all enemies. Inflicts all enemies with DEF Down for 2 turns with a 75% chance. Increases self Action Gauge by 50% and grants self Owner of the Throne (Undispellable) for 3 turns. Grants self a stack of Inferno (Undispellable) for each target hit by a Critical Hit. Stacks up to 3 times.

skills.name: High Score!
skills.descriptionEn: Scarlet triggers Pinball Time! 3 times at the start of the turn, and removes all stacks of Pinball Time! after attacking. Increases self SPD by 1 for each stack of Seven Ball (Undispellable) on self at the start of the turn. Stacks up to 6 times. Normal Ball (Undispellable): Deals 1% increased damage. Seven Ball (Undispellable): Deals 7% increased damage.

skills.name: Here I Come!
skills.descriptionEn: Scarlet swings the detached Tailion at the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: This Doesn't Count!
skills.descriptionEn: Scarlet throws a plate she was holding at the enemy. Inflicts the enemy with Recovery Down for 2 turns with a 100% chance. Grants self an extra turn.

skills.name: Anyway, I Won!
skills.descriptionEn: Scarlet spins a massive pinball around to deal damage to all enemies. Inflicts all enemies with SPD Down for 1 turn with a 75% chance. Reduces this skill's cooldown by 1 turn for each stack of Seven Ball (Undispellable) on self. Resets this skill's cooldown if self has 3 stacks of Seven Ball (Undispellable).

skills.name: Blessing of Premonition
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Seira's ATK by 5%.

skills.name: Fleeting Dream
skills.descriptionEn: Quickly closes in on the enemy and swings her scythe. Grants self 1 stack of Insight.

skills.name: Starlit Butterflies
skills.descriptionEn: Summons starlit butterflies to buff an ally. Grants an ally ATK Up for 2 turns and increases the ally's Action Gauge by 10%. Grants self an extra turn.

skills.name: Invitation to the Phantasm
skills.descriptionEn: Draws the enemy into a dream realm and attacks with a slash. Inflicts the enemy with SPD Down for 2 turns with a 100% chance. Grants self Light of the Phantasm for 2 turns.

skills.name: Rise, Phoenix!
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Serpang's Max HP by 5%.

skills.name: I Choose You!
skills.descriptionEn: Serpang throws Toto at the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: I Trust You!
skills.descriptionEn: Toto intimidates the enemy with a murderous glare. Restores HP to the ally with the current lowest HP ratio, and inflicts the enemy with ATK Down for 1 turn with a 100% chance. Recovery is proportional to self Max HP.

skills.name: Let's Show Them, Toto!
skills.descriptionEn: Serpang and Toto share their fiery bond with everyone. Restores all allies' HP and grants self and the ally with the current lowest HP ratio (excluding Serpang) 1 stack of Skill DMG Nullification. Recovery is proportional to her Max HP.

skills.name: Happy Trigger
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Smile's ATK by 5%.
skills.descriptionZh: 提高自身攻击；敌方生命值不低于 50% 时使用普攻后推进自身行动条。

skills.name: Firing Coordinates Confirmed
skills.descriptionEn: Bombards the enemy with her handmade Happy End cannon. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Leap。

skills.name: Cat Tapdance
skills.descriptionEn: Triggers Cat Tapdance on the enemy if the enemy's HP is 50% or below after using Firing Coordinates Confirmed. Inflicts all enemies with Burn for 1 turn with a 50% chance. Occurs once per turn, and does not trigger if the enemy is defeated by Firing Coordinates Confirmed.
skills.descriptionZh: 当普攻使敌方生命值降至 50% 以下时触发一次，攻击全体敌人并有 50% 概率施加 1 回合 Burn；每回合最多触发一次。

skills.name: All Units, Open Fire!
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes concentrated fire alongside Smile Cat at the enemy. Inflicts the enemy with DEF Down for 2 turns with a 100% chance.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并以 100% 概率施加 2 回合 DEF Down；Nova Burst 时额外造成 1 点韧性伤害并提高伤害 20%。

skills.name: Demolition Work
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Tanya's ATK by 5%.
skills.descriptionZh: 提高自身攻击；击破敌方韧性时获得 Leap 并推进其他队友行动条，Leap 满层时进入 Demolition Mode。

skills.name: Boom-Boom Tool
skills.descriptionEn: Swings her heavy multitool to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，并使自身获得 1 层 Leap。

skills.name: Buzz-Buzz Chainsaw
skills.descriptionEn: Uses the cutting tool in her multitool to slice the enemy. Grants all allies CRIT Rate Up for 1 turn, and increases self Action Gauge by 15%.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人，使全体队友获得 1 回合 CRIT Rate Up，并推进自身行动条 15%。

skills.name: Bang-Bang Bunker
skills.descriptionEn: Pulverizes the enemy with the multitool's drill. Grants self ATK Up for 1 turn. Deals 1 more Toughness DMG if self has Demolition Mode on attack.
skills.descriptionZh: 攻击单个敌人并获得 1 回合 ATK Up；处于 Demolition Mode 时额外造成 1 点韧性伤害。

skills.name: Top-Tier Hunter
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Trish's CRIT DMG by 15%.

skills.name: Phantom Step
skills.descriptionEn: Dashes in with a stylish surprise attack on the enemy. Grants 1 stack of Leap to self.

skills.name: Accelerated Assault
skills.descriptionEn: Throws a dagger, catches it mid-air with style, and slams it down. Grants CRIT Rate Up to self for 2 turns.

skills.name: Continuous Cuts
skills.descriptionEn: Unleashes lightning-fast consecutive strikes that only a top-tier hunter can pull off. Grants ATK Up to self for 2 turns. Upon defeating the enemy, this Skill's cooldown resets.

skills.name: Guillotine Executor
skills.descriptionEn: Penetrates 15% of DEF if the enemy has Thorns of Ruin (Undispellable) when using Prelude to the End or Requiem of Ruin. Inflicts the enemy with Thorns of Ruin (Undispellable) with a 100% chance after using Prelude to the End. Triggers Requiem of Ruin if the enemy's Thorns of Ruin (Undispellable) is at max stacks after using Prelude to the End.

skills.name: Prelude to the End
skills.descriptionEn: Tyria charges towards the enemy with her greatsword. Grants self 1 stack of Ignition.

skills.name: Requiem of Ruin
skills.descriptionEn: Binds the enemy with thorny vines and swings a greatsword with grace. Deals 10% additional damage on attack for each stack of Thorns of Ruin (Undispellable) on self, and deals an additional 50% damage if the enemy is Defender-class. Removes Thorns of Ruin (Undispellable) from the enemy after attacking. Deals 20% increased damage if Ignition is at max stacks on attack. Removes all stacks of Ignition after attacking. Grants self SPD Up for 3 turns if this skill is not an additionally triggered skill.

skills.name: Crescendo of Sorrow
skills.descriptionEn: Slashes through space with a greatsword, dealing massive damage to all enemies. Grants self Shatter for 2 turns, and grants self 2 stacks of Ignition. Inflicts all enemies 1 stack of Thorns of Ruin (Undispellable) with a 100% chance, and inflicts the enemy with the highest DEF 3 stacks of Thorns of Ruin (Undispellable).

skills.name: Veteran Courier
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Vera's Max HP by 3%.

skills.name: Proper Response
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks the enemy with determination to protect the parcel. Grants self 1 stack of Chill.

skills.name: Swift and Safe Delivery
skills.descriptionEn: Vera brings good tidings. Restores an ally's HP and removes 1 debuff from the ally. Recovery is proportional to her Max HP.

skills.name: One Step Toward My Dream
skills.descriptionEn: Vera completes a special delivery. Restores all allies' HP. Grants self Express Delivery for 1 turn if the target has a buff. Recovery is proportional to Muriel's Max HP.

skills.name: Experienced Rookie
skills.descriptionEn: Increases Yoo Mina's ATK by 2% after attacking. Stacks up to 5 times. Increases self Action Gauge by 9% on Critical Hit.

skills.name: Pulse Revolver
skills.descriptionEn: Attacks the enemy using her Pulse Revolver. Grants self 1 stack of Leap.

skills.name: Pulse Impact
skills.descriptionEn: Fires high-output energy from the Pulse Revolver to attack the enemy. Grants self CRIT Rate Up for 2 turns and inflicts the enemy with Bleed for 2 turns with a 75% chance. Inflicts the enemy with an additional instance of Bleed for 2 turns with a 100% chance if Leap is at max stacks after attacking.

skills.name: Wolvesbane
skills.descriptionEn: Swings Wolvesbane to attack all enemies. Grants self ATK Up for 2 turns and 2 stacks of Leap. Inflicts all enemies with an instance of Bleed for 2 turns with a 75% chance, 2 times total.
